map.链接 https://shop.com、source=zhihu、medium=: Link https://shop.com with source=zhihu, medium=organic and campaign=brand gives https://shop.com?utm_source=zhihu&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=brand.
map.source 用平台、medium 用 cpc/organic、campaign: Use the platform for source, cpc / organic for medium and a dated code for campaign, all lower case with no spaces, so GA splits traffic stably.

map.无顺序要求，解析按参数名，保持一致命名习惯更重要。: No. Parsing works by parameter name, so keeping naming habits consistent matters more.
